invariants: Own Python 3.8 runtime, pinned ripgrep 1.18.0, bundled framework and GUI; all five profiles dump configuration with isolated packaged interpreter.
Fresh profile boot and shutdown work outside host Python import paths.
identity: Portable launchers select adjacent Python 3.8 and dsh.py, independent of PATH.
ownership: Build owns generated dist folder/zip; source checkout remains development input.
ordering: Resolve pinned ripgrep metadata and Python DLL before replacing output; stage runtime, framework, frontend and dependencies, then zip.
errors: Missing pinned ripgrep or Python runtime fails loudly; packaged smoke must fail rather than fall back to host Python.
cancellation: Build is synchronous; interrupted output is not a validated release.
adaptation: Only current Windows runtime smoke is specified here. Win7 SP1/browser validation is explicitly deferred by user; no certification inferred.
